title: cynoglossum heterocarpum
intro: Cynoglossum heterocarpum, commonly known as the variable-fruit toad-flax, is a type of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum heterocarpum include its ability to act as a bronchodilator and a diuretic, helping to relieve asthma symptoms and promote urine production. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
